parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the results to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the results start from page 1.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end timestamp of the repair task that you want to query. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paginated query. Default value: **20**, which indicates that up to 20 entries are returned per page.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start timestamp of the repair task that you want to query. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the image repair task that you want to query. Valid values:

- **1**: Repairing
- **2**: Repaired
- **3**: Repair failed
